name: Ed Reece
office: City of Claremont, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Ed Reece is the Vice Mayor of Claremont, serving his second term on the City Council. He is the CEO of a technology firm he founded, and he served on the city's police commission before joining the council. His campaign says he supports focusing on core services: police staffing and training, maintaining parks and sports fields, expanding senior and youth programs, repairing streets and sidewalks, and balancing the budget without raising taxes.

sentences.text: Ed Reece is the Vice Mayor of Claremont, serving his second term on the City Council.
He is the CEO of a technology firm he founded, and he served on the city's police commission before joining the council.

His campaign says he supports focusing on core services: police staffing and training, maintaining parks and sports fields, expanding senior and youth programs, repairing streets and sidewalks, and balancing the budget without raising taxes.

items.text: In 2022, as chair of the Foothill Gold Line Construction Authority, he said his goal was to get funding to extend the light-rail line to Claremont and Montclair. In 2026, the board advanced the Claremont Extension project, awarding a design and engineering contract.
